questions.question: Which type of surveillance is specifically aimed at identifying missing cases of disease?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sentinel surveillance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Missing cases of disease:-**

 
 
• It refer to cases that have not been reported to health authorities.
 
 
 
• **Surveillance:-**
 
 
• It is the ongoing systematic collection, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of data on a health event for use in public health action to reduce morbidity and mortality and to improve health.
 
• The four types of surveillance are overt, passive, active, and sentinel.
 
• Sentinel surveillance is specifically aimed at identifying missing cases of disease.
 
• 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Overt surveillance:-**

 
 
• It is a type of surveillance in which data collection is conducted openly and with full knowledge of those being monitored.
 
 
 
• **Passive surveillance:-**
 
 
• It is a type of surveillance in which data is collected from existing sources, such as hospitals and clinics, without active reporting by healthcare providers.
 
 
 
• **Active surveillance:-**
 
 
• It is a type of surveillance in which healthcare providers are contacted regularly to report specific conditions.

questions.question: Which of the following is a rare group of genetic disorders caused by mutations of certain genes affecting the colour (pigmentation) of the skin, hair and eyes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Albinism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Albinism** is a rare group of genetic disorders caused by mutations of certain genes affecting the color (pigmentation) of the skin, hair, and eyes.
 
• People with albinism are at risk of skin and vision problems due to the lack of melanin, the pigment responsible for coloration.
 
• Albinism can occur in all racial and ethnic groups.
 
• There is no cure for albinism, but individuals can manage symptoms with proper skin care and eye protection.
 
• Genetic counseling is recommended for families affected by albinism to understand the inheritance patterns and risks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oculocutaneous albinism (OCA)** is the most common form, affecting the skin, hair, and eyes.
 
• **Ocular albinism** primarily affects the eyes, with minimal or no impact on skin and hair color.
 
• Individuals with albinism should avoid excessive sun exposure and use sunscreen to protect their skin.
 
• Regular eye check-ups and visual aids can help manage vision issues associated with albinism.
 
• Public awareness and education are crucial to reduce the stigma and discrimination faced by individuals with albinism.

questions.question: What level of prevention is targeted by water defluoridation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary prevention.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Primary prevention:-**

 
 
• **Water defluoridation is a primary level of prevention. **
 
• Primary prevention is **aimed at preventing the occurrence of a disease or condition before it even begins.**
 
• In the case of water defluoridation, the goal is to prevent dental and skeletal fluorosis by removing excess fluoride from drinking water.
 
• Dental fluorosis is a condition that causes discoloration and pitting of the teeth.
 
• Skeletal fluorosis is a more serious condition that can cause bone pain, stiffness, and deformities.
 
• Both dental and skeletal fluorosis can be caused by consuming excessive amounts of fluoride, especially during childhood.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Tertiary prevention:-**

 
 
• It reduces the severity of a disease or condition and improve quality of life after it has already occurred.
 
 
 
• **Secondary prevention:-**
 
 
• It detects and treat a disease or condition early, before it causes serious harm.
 
 
 
• **Primordial prevention:-**
 
 
• It prevents the development of a disease or condition before it even begins.

questions.question: Which of the following viruses is responsible for causing influenza?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Myxovirus__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Myxovirus **can cause **Influenza** in humans.
 
• **Myxovirus **belongs to the **families Orthomyxoviridae** (agents of influenza) and **Paramyxoviridae**.
 
• There are two main types of influenza (flu) virus: **Types A and B.**
 
• **The influenza A and B viruses** that routinely **spread in people** (human influenza viruses) are **responsible for seasonal flu** epidemics each year.
 
• **Influenza A viruses** can be broken down into **sub-types depending** on the genes that make up the surface proteins.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Viruses responsible for several diseases are**__:

 
• Smallpox - variola virus
 
• Polio - poliomyelitis
 
• Rabies - Lyssavirus 
 
• Mumps - paramyxovirus

questions.question: Hypokalaemia is caused by the deficiency of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Potassium.

__
 
• **Potassium**__ is the most common electrolyte for the human body.
 
• Hypokalaemia is a disease caused by a lower level of potassium.
 
• Potassium is very important electrolytes required in the formation of Adenosine triphosphate(ATP) and Na-K ATPase pump.

questions.question: Which type of pathogen causes the water-borne disease Ascariasis?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Parasitic.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Key facts about pathogens and the diseases caused by them:
 
• Parasitic type of pathogen causes the water-borne disease Ascariasis.
 
• It is a roundworm organism found in the small intestine and mostly occurs in children.
 
• The infection takes place by eating food or drinking contaminated water with Ascaris eggs from human excreta.
 
• Abdominal pain, Abdominal swelling, shortness of breathing, fever and diarrhoea are the main symptoms of this disease.
 
• Ascaris is a commonly found parasitic worm in humans.
 
• Ascariasis, a type of helminthiasis, is one of the groups of neglected tropical diseases. 
 
• This disease is prevalent worldwide, especially in tropical and subtropical countries.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a symptom of Beriberi caused due to the deficiency of Vitamin B1?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Slowly healing wounds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beriberi**

 
 
• Beriberi is caused due to the **deficiency of Vitamin B1** and sometimes it is also referred to as **thiamine deficiency**.
 
• The **two primary types** of beriberi are:
 
 
• **Wet beriberi**
 
• **Dry beriberi**
 
 
 
• The **circulatory and heart systems** are affected by **wet beriberi**. Wet beriberi can occasionally result in **cardiac failure**.
 
• **Dry beriberi harms the nerves**, which can result in **weakened muscles and ultimately muscle paralysis**.
 
• **Symptoms of wet beriberi:**
 
 
• rapid heart rate
 
• breath shortness during physical activity
 
• lower legs swelling
 
• Middle-of-the-night insomnia (MOTN)
 
 
 
• **Symptoms of dry beriberi:**
 
 
• Involuntary eye movement
 
• Difficulty speaking
 
• pain in the limbs
 
• paralysis
 
• vomiting​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome** and beriberi are **associated **with each other as it is a kind of **brain injury due to thiamine deficiency**. 
 
• **Other causes of beriberi:**
 
 
• It is also commonly observed in those who **abuse alcohol**, which makes it **harder for body cells to absorb and store vitamin B1**.
 
• In extremely rare instances,** beriberi may also be a genetic condition** that is passed from **mother to child during breastfeeding**.
 
• **Hyperthyroidism**
 
 
 
• This disease can be **treated by restoring the blood cell level of thiamine **by increasing daily vitamin consumption.
 
• **Thiamine supplements** are administered** orally or intravenously** to treat patients (injection).
